Opening the official Top 5 video now and checking the first segment’s title card.

The visuals and narration clearly focus on emperor penguins in Antarctica, including close-ups of adult plumage and chicks. The description references emperor penguins specifically. Based on this, the bird species featured is the Emperor penguin.

mistake_reason: At step 4, WebSurfer explicitly stated they were opening the official "Top 5 Silliest Animal Moments" video to check the first segment, but instead opened a different BBC Earth video titled "Emperor penguins | The Greatest Wildlife Show on Earth." This reasoning-action mismatch (FM-2.6) led them to conclude the species was "Emperor penguin," contradicting the plan to verify within the correct video. The discrepancy directly caused the final wrong answer, whereas the correct species in the referenced video is Rockhopper penguin.
